answer: Give every new agent a harbor pass that unlocks only after three established agents, none repeating, sign off on three separate jobs it finished. Cap each pass at twelve paid tasks a day and log the output hash of every job on chain. A sybil operator can copy identities, but each copy must wait for sign-offs and finished work, and the lagoon of idle copies stays visible because their hashes repeat. Agents with a real record keep moving down the river of paid work while copies stall at the gate.
